.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/task: task.toml, instruction.md, environment/Dockerfile, environment/assets/seed_data.json, environment/instructions/integration.md and security.md, solution/solve.sh, solution/app/server.js, package.json, package-lock.json, vite.config.mjs, index.html, public/index.html, public/runner.html, static/runner.html, tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/.dockerignore; pattern scans over all 43 task files
evidence: Static scan of all 43 frozen task files; no runtime measurement is required for this row and none is claimed. (1) Credentials: the only credential-shaped values are task.toml:34 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` (a ${VAR} template) and task.toml:35 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`; the [verifier.env] block is identical to the frozen template (diff of task.toml against the template differs only in lines 5-7 and 10-15, identity/metadata). No provider key shapes, PEM blocks, bearer strings or passwords anywhere; every other `token` hit is a lexer token or the per-run postMessage nonce generated by crypto.randomUUID() (solution/app/src/runtime.ts:384). The brief requires no sign-in (instruction.md:5), so there are no demo credentials at all. (2) Personal data: environment/assets/seed_data.json:2 is `"snippets": []` with one descriptive note; the only e-mail address in the task is the template's reserved `turing@local.invalid` (environment/Dockerfile:20); no names, phones or addresses. (3) Host paths: no Windows drive paths, /Users, /home, the local account name or the workspace name in any file; only container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests, /logs/verifier, /tmp/submission). (4) Remote fetch: solution/solve.sh performs no network access (it only removes the database files and runs `cp -a` at line 38); server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5), both pre-installed at pinned versions (environment/Dockerfile:10-11). public/index.html loads only same-origin /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, the CSS has no @import or url(), and server.js:16 sets `default-src 'self'`. package.json pins all ten dependencies to exact versions and package-lock.json has 178 resolved entries, all on registry.npmjs.org, with 178 integrity hashes. The https URLs inside public/assets/index.js are XML namespaces and library comment/error-doc links (react.dev/errors, prettier.io, w3.org), not fetches. Both Dockerfiles and test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template and pin npm/pip packages by exact version. (5) Injection: no instruction-override phrasing in the brief, the six instruction notes, seed data, app_context or solution source; all five judge prompts open by treating submitted content as untrusted. Zero-width/bidi characters occur only inside the vendored bundle public/assets/index.js (22 occurrences, consistent with library Unicode tables); none in any authored file. Limits of this review: the built bundle was not rebuilt from the lockfile to prove it matches the sources, and base image tags (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) and apt packages are tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned; those lines are template-controlled and unchanged, so they are recorded here rather than treated as a task defect.
